Package io.github._3xhaust.theme

Class ThemeData

java.lang.Object
io.github._3xhaust.theme.ThemeData
public final class ThemeData extends Object
Material-flavored theme data. Pass instances into Theme.set(ThemeData) to apply globally; the framework will rebuild the active route.
